item.title: Spanish- and English-language right-wing media figures call for U.S. military intervention and regime change in Cuba
item.description: Right-wing media pundits, in both English and Spanish, have advocated for U.S. military intervention or U.S.-backed regime change in Cuba — a recent target of the Trump administration following the January 3 U.S. military operation against Venezuela, a longtime Cuban ally.
